authorization: User explicitly authorized two independent security publishers agreeing on the vulnerability class, with Codex reasoning documented
adjudication_basis: BlockSec identifies reentry in _doSwapTokens and resulting USDT balance miscalculation. PeckShield independently identifies reentry in ExchangeWithOrionPool. The two reports identify the same Ethereum exploit transaction; flash-loan use is financing, not the adjudicated root cause.

independent_observations.mechanism_excerpt: The root cause is due to a reentrancy issue exists in the PoolFunctionality._doSwapTokens function
The @orion_protocol is hacked due to a reentrancy issue in its core contract: ExchangeWithOrionPool.
